title: Path traversal
skill: List the attacks and the allowed cases

good: In src/lib/safePath.js, safeJoin(root, userPath) only checks full.startsWith(root), so "../public-backup/x" and absolute paths escape /srv/app/public. Rules: decodeURIComponent(userPath) once first; throw an Error if the decoded path is absolute or if any "/" segment is exactly ".." (so "%2e%2e/x" and "docs/../a.txt" throw, but "a..b.txt" and "..hidden" are fine); allow nested folders; resolve against root and require the result to start with root + path.sep; return the absolute decoded path ("my%20notes.txt" -> "/srv/app/public/my notes.txt"). Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Fix the path traversal hole in the static file server.
